title: Assigned member interview workflow
baseline: Requested scope: template-based interviewing with in-application recording and automatic transcription. Prototype basis: admin-case-intake.html (person interviewed, interviewer, method, date/time, location, duration, notes and attachments). Existing council testimony is a separate event: do not silently apply its permissions or AI-provider approval to every private interview. Original audio, versions and actual authorship must be preserved.
sections: scope
Interview scope & participants
Who can be interviewed and by whom.
Should this interview workflow be separate from applicant testimony given during a council session?
Both link to the case/proceeding, but a case-owner interview is not automatically a council hearing or agenda item.
Should only the assigned council member conduct and author these case-investigation interviews?
Use Other to name additional permitted interviewers. Prototype selection of any council member is not yet an approved permission.
May admin or secretary enter or upload an interview record on the assigned member’s behalf?
Preserve the actual interviewer separately from the person entering the data. This does not authorize applicant appeal supplements on their behalf.
Should the interviewee list include either applicant, their priest or Father of Confession, and adult witnesses?
These types appear in the prototype. No child interviews or child accounts are proposed.
Should a witness or priest be recorded as a case-linked contact without creating a login account?
Store only the identity/contact details needed for the interview and preserve their relationship to the case.
Should both applicants always be interviewed separately?
Use Other if the assigned member may sometimes conduct a joint interview; existing council testimony still never places both applicants together.
templates
Interview templates
Reusable questions without rewriting history.
Should admin or secretary create and version the interview templates?
Each interview retains the exact template version used; publishing changes must not rewrite completed interviews.
Should templates vary by interviewee type, such as applicant, spouse, priest or witness?
Use Other to prefer one common template or describe a simpler structure.
Should interview templates support English and Arabic versions of the same questions?
Keep original answers in the language spoken/entered rather than replacing them with translations.
Should the assigned member be able to add case-specific follow-up questions within an interview?
Keep the published template unchanged and record which questions were added for this case.
Should the template allow both structured fields and rich-text answers?
For example dates or Yes/No plus detailed narrative. Use Other to prefer narrative-only interview notes.
Should an interview show the selected applicant’s submitted answers beside the template for reference?
The interviewer may compare assertions but must not overwrite them through the interview record. Other party information remains separately attributed.
process
Conducting & saving the interview
Template-led information gathering.
Should the interview preserve the prototype metadata: person, actual interviewer, method, date/time, location and duration?
Methods currently shown are in person, phone and virtual. Other may refine the list or fields.
Should the assigned member be able to save an unfinished interview and resume later?
This is an investigation-record draft, separate from the no-draft Send action for a council-hearing update.
Should each completed interview be an individual entry in a chronological case-interview log?
Allow multiple interviews of the same person without overwriting earlier interviews.
Should evidence discussed during an interview be linked to specific questions or notes?
Reuse retained file versions. Do not duplicate source files or make the interviewee the owner of someone else’s evidence.
Should the assigned member have a separate internal observations/recommendations area alongside the interviewee’s answers?
Do not blend council conclusions into the interviewee’s recorded statements.
recording
Audio recording
Recording inside the template workflow.
Should recording be optional for ordinary case-owner interviews?
Recording capability is requested, but mandatory versus optional is undecided. Council-session applicant testimony remains mandatory audio recording.
Should the interviewer record that the interviewee was informed about recording before audio capture starts?
This asks for a workflow record; exact institutional wording/policy remains to be supplied, not invented here.
Should an interview support both microphone recording in CTM and uploading an existing audio file?
Open-source recorder requirement is already noted. Original bytes and the actual recorder/uploader remain recorded.
Should interview recording support pause/resume and recovery of captured portions after an interruption?
Recovery must preserve the actual timeline and gaps, without inventing missing audio.
Should the no-fixed-duration/file-size-cap rule for council testimony also apply to these investigation interview recordings?
This extends the testimony exception to interview recordings. Ordinary applicant audio attachments would retain their existing limit.
Should the interviewer be able to mark the current template question while recording so transcript segments can link to it?
Markers guide navigation; they do not establish that every spoken statement is an answer to that question.
transcription
Transcription & translation
Keep generated text separate from reviewed facts.
Should saving an interview recording automatically queue transcription through the approved-for-interviews AI API?
Testimony AI processing is already requested; this question explicitly extends external audio processing to case-owner interviews. Provider selection comes later.
Should interview transcripts use the same language behavior as testimony: original transcript, English/Arabic translation, and all three versions for mixed speech?
Include timestamps and speaker labels; preserve the source recording and original AI output.
Should AI suggest which transcript passages answer each template question, for the assigned member to review?
Suggestions never become verified interview answers automatically and must link back to timestamped source audio.
Should the assigned member review and correct generated interview text before other council members can read it?
Use Other if admin/secretary should review instead or also. Every correction retains author/time and earlier versions.
Should manually typed interview answers remain separate from the AI transcript even after review?
This avoids presenting edited summaries as verbatim testimony; both can reference the original audio.
access
Access, history & case use
Who sees working and completed interview material.
Should unfinished interview records be visible only to the assigned member, admin and secretary?
Use Other if all council should see them immediately or if drafts should be author-only. Applicant drafts remain governed separately.
Should completed interviews, audio and reviewed transcripts be visible to all authorized council members?
No applicant access is inferred. Use Other to specify a narrower audience.
Should interview records, recordings and transcripts remain council-only, with any applicant-facing request sent through normal case messages?
This keeps internal investigation material separate from the applicant’s own form history.
Should the original interviewer be the only person able to revise their completed interview narrative while the case is open?
Use Other to allow admin/secretary corrections or the newly assigned member. Preserve every version; closure freezes substantive source records.
After reassignment, should the new assigned member add follow-up interviews rather than rewrite the earlier interviewer’s narrative?
Earlier authorship and recordings remain intact; they may be read under the approved council scope.
Should the assigned member choose reviewed interview findings for the case-hearing briefing instead of automatically sharing the entire transcript?
Council source material remains accessible under its permission rules. No automatic decree content or applicant disclosure is implied.
